notes:
First public release of FixLags for Windows (paid beta).

- Free to download and use: account, game selection, direct network measurements, diagnostics and network recovery.
- Relay routing (Smart and manual Relay modes through the FixLags relay in Germany) needs an active subscription; your PC is set up automatically after sign-in, with its own WireGuard key.
- Automatic, signed updates: FixLags checks for a new version shortly after start and every 6 hours and shows "FixLags vX.Y.Z is available". Nothing installs without your click; the relay is disconnected and your routes are restored first.
- Settings → Updates: installed version, "Check for updates", download progress and these notes.

Known limitations: one relay location; IPv4 only; the installer is not Authenticode-signed yet (Windows SmartScreen warns); administrator rights are needed at install and at every start; FixLags cannot guarantee a lower ping and shows measured results only.
